39: class DrillSidewaysScorer extends BulkScorer {
40: 
41:   private static final Comparator<DocsAndCost> APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR =
42:       Comparator.comparingLong(e -> e.cost);
43: 
44:   private static final Comparator<DocsAndCost> TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR =
45:       (a, b) -> Float.compare(a.matchCost, b.matchCost);
46: 
47:   // private static boolean DEBUG = false;
48: 
49:   private final Collector drillDownCollector;
50:   private LeafCollector drillDownLeafCollector;
51: 
52:   private final DocsAndCost[] dims;
53: 
54:   // DrillDown DocsEnums:
55:   private final Scorer baseScorer;
56:   private final DocIdSetIterator baseIterator;
57:   private final DocIdSetIterator baseApproximation;
58:   private final TwoPhaseIterator baseTwoPhase;
59: 
60:   private final LeafReaderContext context;
61: 
62:   final boolean scoreSubDocsAtOnce;
63: 
64:   private static final int CHUNK = 2048;
65:   private static final int MASK = CHUNK - 1;
66: 
67:   private int collectDocID = -1;
68:   private float collectScore;
69: 
70:   DrillSidewaysScorer(
71:       LeafReaderContext context,
72:       Scorer baseScorer,
73:       Collector drillDownCollector,
74:       DocsAndCost[] dims,
75:       boolean scoreSubDocsAtOnce) {
76:     this.dims = dims;
77:     this.context = context;
78:     this.baseScorer = baseScorer;
79:     this.baseIterator = baseScorer.iterator();
80:     this.baseTwoPhase = baseScorer.twoPhaseIterator();
81:     if (baseTwoPhase != null) {
82:       this.baseApproximation = baseTwoPhase.approximation();
83:     } else {
84:       this.baseApproximation = baseIterator;
85:     }
86:     this.drillDownCollector = drillDownCollector;
87:     this.scoreSubDocsAtOnce = scoreSubDocsAtOnce;
88:   }
89: 
90:   @Override
91:   public long cost() {
92:     return baseIterator.cost();
93:   }
94: 
95:   @Override
96:   public int score(LeafCollector collector, Bits acceptDocs, int min, int maxDoc)
97:       throws IOException {
98:     if (min != 0) {
99:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("min must be 0, got " + min);
100:     }
101:     if (maxDoc != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
102:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxDoc must be Integer.MAX_VALUE");
103:     }
104:     // if (DEBUG) {
105:     //  System.out.println("\nscore: reader=" + context.reader());
106:     // }
107:     // System.out.println("score r=" + context.reader());
108:     if (drillDownCollector != null) {
109:       drillDownLeafCollector = drillDownCollector.getLeafCollector(context);
110:     } else {
111:       drillDownLeafCollector = null;
112:     }
113:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
114:       dim.sidewaysLeafCollector = dim.sidewaysCollector.getLeafCollector(context);
115:     }
116: 
117:     // some scorers, eg ReqExlScorer, can hit NPE if cost is called after nextDoc
118:     long baseQueryCost = baseIterator.cost();
119: 
120:     final int numDims = dims.length;
121: 
122:     long drillDownCost = 0;
123:     for (int dim = 0; dim < numDims; dim++) {
124:       drillDownCost += dims[dim].approximation.cost();
125:     }
126: 
127:     long drillDownAdvancedCost = 0;
128:     if (numDims > 1) {
129:       drillDownAdvancedCost = dims[1].approximation.cost();
130:     }
131: 
132:     // Position all scorers to their first matching doc:
133:     baseIterator.nextDoc();
134:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
135:       dim.approximation.nextDoc();
136:     }
137: 
138:     /*
139:     System.out.println("\nbaseDocID=" + baseScorer.docID() + " est=" + estBaseHitCount);
140:     System.out.println("  maxDoc=" + context.reader().maxDoc());
141:     System.out.println("  maxCost=" + maxCost);
142:     System.out.println("  dims[0].freq=" + dims[0].freq);
143:     if (numDims > 1) {
144:       System.out.println("  dims[1].freq=" + dims[1].freq);
145:     }
146:     */
147: 
148:     if (scoreSubDocsAtOnce || baseQueryCost < drillDownCost / 10) {
149:       // System.out.println("queryFirst: baseScorer=" + baseScorer + " disis.length=" + disis.length
150:       // + " bits.length=" + bits.length);
151:       doQueryFirstScoring(acceptDocs, collector, dims);
152:     } else if (numDims > 1 && drillDownAdvancedCost < baseQueryCost / 10) {
153:       // System.out.println("drillDownAdvance");
154:       doDrillDownAdvanceScoring(acceptDocs, collector, dims);
155:     } else {
156:       // System.out.println("union");
157:       doUnionScoring(acceptDocs, collector, dims);
158:     }
159: 
160:     return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
161:   }
162: 
163:   /**
164:    * Query-first scoring specialization when there is only one drill-sideways dimension, which is
165:    * likely a common scenario.
166:    */
167:   private void doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(
168:       Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost dim) throws IOException {
169:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
170:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
171:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
172: 
173:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
174:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
175:         continue;
176:       }
177: 
178:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
179:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
180:         continue;
181:       }
182: 
183:       // We have either a near-miss or full match. Check the sideways dim to see which it is:
184:       collectDocID = docID;
185:       if (advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation) != docID
186:           || (dim.twoPhase != null && dim.twoPhase.matches() == false)) {
187:         // The sideways dim missed, so we have a "near miss":
188:         collectNearMiss(dim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
189:       } else {
190:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
191:         collectHit(collector, dim);
192:       }
193: 
194:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
195:     }
196:   }
197:

part.text:
Fix implemented and validated.

**Change** in `lucene/facet/src/java/org/apache/lucene/facet/DrillSidewaysScorer.java` (matching upstream fix `df1b0ba`):
- Removed the shared `baseIterator.nextDoc()` call before the scoring branches — with a two-phase base iterator (e.g. `PhraseQuery`'s `ExactPhraseMatcher`), it invoked the costly `matches()` once, and the branch logic then invoked it a second time without repositioning, causing undefined behavior and missed docs.
- Instead, each branch now positions the base scorer itself: the query-first path uses `baseApproximation.nextDoc()` (so the first `matches()` confirmation happens only inside the branch), while the drill-down-advance and union paths use `baseIterator.nextDoc()` as before.

**Validation** (in the container):
- `TestDrillSideways` — all 11 tests pass, including the previously failing `testDrillSidewaysSearchUseCorrectIterator`.
- Full `:lucene:facet:test` module — build successful, no regressions.
